title: ID0416937-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/24]  ENGIE-Cable not installed
description: Reported issue: The cable management system at the right side of the charger is not well installed. Indeed, the yellow ring inside the cable support is not present so the support is sliding around the cable. Can you please send the ticket to the french team to plan an intervention on site ? Thank you,
